title: Final Magnetic Field
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the magnetic field B(s) must be correctly derived and presented for both cases of s relative to a.

title: Bound Current Density
description: Essential Criteria: The bound current density J_b must be correctly expressed in terms of susceptibility and free current density.

title: Surface Current Density
description: Important Criteria: The surface bound current density K_b must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Net Bound Current
description: Essential Criteria: The net bound current I_b must be correctly calculated and shown to be zero.

title: Free Current Density
description: Important Criteria: The free current density J_f must be correctly identified and used in calculations.

title: Symmetry Argument
description: Optional Criteria: A clear explanation of the symmetry argument leading to the form of H(s) should be included.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing the correct factors or signs in the expressions for B(s) or J_b will result in significant deductions.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failure to maintain consistent units throughout the derivation will result in deductions.
